verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a public Terminal API for payments, refunds, shopper data collection and other terminal interactions, using JSON messages over local network or cloud. A Management API covers terminal operations such as ordering, webhooks report asynchronous outcomes, and an official GitHub repo publishes OpenAPI definitions; the 404s on docs-domain OpenAPI paths only mean the spec is hosted elsewhere. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that the current Terminal API works well when driven programmatically (the only community report describes an older COM-based integration).
